policy.deletion: none — this audit never removes, relabels or merges a row
policy.cefr: legacy distribution reads `level:` tags; sense evidence reports stored sense claims separately
policy.senseLevel: sense arrays may split a row; this report counts their stored evidence claims without validating the mappings
policy.phrases: a phrase is kept at its own stored level and is never judged by the level of its cheapest constituent word

legacyTagEvidence.qualification: stored legacy tags only; their source claims were not independently validated by this report

senseEvidence.qualification: stored generator claims, not independently verified; an unset validation flag does not imply approval
